verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships a documented REST API, a self-hosted single-binary/CLI install, and an official MCP server; runtime probes confirm a real keyless index+typo-tolerant search roundtrip via the API and a working stdio JSON-RPC handshake with the official MCP server, matching docs that claim index creation, document addition, and search via natural-language MCP prompts. Missing for 10: a captured end-to-end MCP session showing the agent itself creating an index and running a query (only the handshake was probed, not the full workflow) and an independent (non-vendor) confirmation of the MCP tool's search behavior.
